originality.rationale: The autonomous model is exactly conjugate by positive scalings to the older BB predator–prey system (van Voorn et al., 2007), so model structure, Hopf crossing and supercritical direction are not new. The new mathematical assertion is the explicit strictly negative nonlinear angular frequency coefficient and its original-time logarithmic phase asymptotic, absent from the 2007 and 2011 inspected full texts as well as the 2026 introducing source. This narrowly specified novelty remains provisional.
residual_risks: The BB model (2007) is dynamically identical under positive scalings; only the unreported explicit critical phase coefficient and time-asymptotic law are asserted as new.
Unindexed early normal-form analyses of the BB model might contain this evaluated nonlinear frequency coefficient; historical priority remains provisional.
The theorem is local and not uniform in the singular small-timescale limit.
